annotations.text: Read the cover first: the three findings, the six moves, the four-part rule. The two specimen boards beside it show a rule in frames. Page 2 holds the surfaces.
Blue Mantis Divers, the week of Thursday August 27, 2026. Every name is invented. Reef in Geist on the staff boards; the demo shop's green and Bricolage Grotesque on the diver's.

This page opens only from Yara's own link. A cold visitor gets the form that ships. Whether an email typed cold that matches a diver may receive one link is the owner's call (H-68 b); nothing shows on the page either way.
The crew field is the one value on this panel that schedules people. Whether the pattern may fill it, or leaves it empty with the sentence, is H-68 c.
The palette answers; it never mutates. Each act lands on the page whose form does the work, with that form ready.
